notes.title: A Letter to All Players
notes.notes: [p]Hello everyone.[/p][p]After a long development process, my game is finally ready to meet you all. Here, I have something to share with you.[/p][p]Developing a game entirely on my own has indeed been a fascinating experience. I've learned far more during the game development process than I did in the past few years of classroom learning. Although I encountered various difficulties and challenges along the way, overall, it has been an interesting journey. I hope this game can bring you the same joy.[/p][p]Unfortunately, I must admit that the current version of the game falls far short of my expectations. Due to considerations regarding game performance and production schedules, I had to temporarily cancel some planned content, even though the development of some features was nearly complete. However, before introducing more elaborate content, it's necessary to gather your feedback and suggestions on the game's core elements to adjust the subsequent development plan. Of course, in the early access version, you can still experience the most distinctive features of this game: social deduction based on proximity voice chat and random item generation. You can find various interesting items in the game, use them to arm yourself, attack enemies, and even change your faction or communicate with the deceased. I guarantee that this will be a novel experience unlike any other social deduction game you've played before.[/p][p]Although the game performed well in previous small-scale tests, I'm fully aware of my own technical limitations. There may still be undiscovered issues in the early access version of the game. If these problems seriously affect your normal gaming experience, I sincerely apologize. If you encounter any issues during gameplay, please feel free to provide feedback via [b]service@hachimi.work[/b]. I will closely monitor the feedback and do my best to resolve all bugs and critical issues that affect gameplay. You can also join the Sanitism community on Discord to find solutions provided by other players :​[url="https://discord.gg/8VjR8ZBX"]Sanitism[/url] .[/p][p]I understand that Sanitism is still a rather immature game at this stage. Therefore, I earnestly request that you offer me your valuable suggestions to help me polish and improve it. Finally, thank you for your patience and support. I sincerely invite you to continue witnessing the growth of Sanitism.[/p][p]Thank you all again![/p][p]K.O.H[/p]
